title: Simulation illustrations: AI-assisted coronary CT angiography and myocardial infarction prediction
description: Companion code for the manuscript 'From plaque measurement to myocardial infarction prediction: a critical review of artificial intelligence in coronary CT angiography with simulation illustrations'. Five simulation experiments on SCOT-HEART-like simulated cohorts quantify outcome-selected threshold optimism, platform shift of volumetric plaque thresholds, competing death, incremental C-statistic instability and composite endpoints with scan-triggered revascularisation. No patient data are used.
